name: @foundationforest/markets
description: The Forest markets: the directory, the shared lists and each market file, and the answers every program shares: checkEntry, whether an entry fits; match, whether two answers of one field match; and ask, what a market asks a role; and read, a helper that says an answer in plain English, not part of the standard. The package reads them from a markets checkout; its browser entry takes the same files as data, and runs no code made from strings. check.sh checks every market file, and writes directory.json and directory.md from them.
